column3: With respect to the Greensboro-High Point Marriott Airport Mortgage Loan (2.7%), the ground lease with respect to the Mortgaged Property requires the Mortgaged Property to be used for the operation of the Marriott hotel currently located on the Mortgaged Property or any other nationally recognized first-class hotel, provided that the premises may not be used for car rentals, airline ticket counters, or parking for anyone who is not conducting business with or at the hotel.
